description: Open-source long-term memory for AI agents that stays correct as facts change. The npm package oortmem is a TypeScript SDK, the oort command line and an MCP server; the Python package oortmem is a native client. Old facts are closed out instead of overwritten, and recall returns what is true now.
rules: Put memory into a prompt only through formatForPrompt (TypeScript) or format_for_prompt (Python). It escapes the block; never concatenate memory text into a prompt.
Keep keys in the environment or a secret manager, never in source code, a committed config, a prompt or a log line. On a server pass keySources: ['env'] or ['explicit'].
In a multi-user app keep one root handle per tenant (org, never 'local') in trusted host code, and give the model only a handle scoped to one end user: oort.scoped({ user: userId }).
Create one handle per process and close it with await using or close(). Await observe before a serverless function returns.
Call observe after the answer is sent. Use remember only for facts the user stated or confirmed.
Handle errors by OortError.code, not the message, and retry only errors that are retryable, waiting retryAfter seconds when it is set.
Model-facing code runs in the agent judge role; use judge: { role: 'expert' } only on a code path where a person really decided.
